link.title: Managing Cloud Assets
link.description: Cloud assets live in your Bitbybit project and are available to every script in it, which makes them the right choice for anything you want to reuse or share. Upload a model, a texture or a data file once and reference it from as many scripts as you like, without asking a visitor to provide it. These pages cover uploading assets to a project, referencing them from a script, using images as textures on your geometry, and the practical differences between cloud storage and loading a file from the local machine.
